headline: Palantine Berm Erupts as Northern Fronts Face Renewed Turmoil
war_summary: Combat has intensified sharply across the northern perimeter since the last edition, led by a violent resurgence in Palantine Berm where fifteen base transitions erupted over the past two hours, though Warden garrisons presently retain control of all seven strongpoints. In Weathered Expanse, six fresh engagements left the sector partitioned between five Colonial redoubts, three Warden holdings, and one neutral ruin as Warden casualties mounted past eleven hundred in the latest two-hour tally. Nevish Line remains fiercely embattled, with a contested strongpoint falling into no-man's-land to shift the balance to six Warden bases, one Colonial, and one destroyed. Across Marban Hollow, the frantic base captures of previous hours have paused, yet the sector remains an inferno with over five thousand casualties recorded in two hours amidst accelerating losses. By contrast, the recently reclaimed frontiers of Kuura Strand and Viper Pit have subsided into relative stillness, while the long-grinding slugfests across Callahan’s Passage, Mooring County, and Stlican Shelf press forward without giving ground.
